paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.32% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.60%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.26%). Brent crude changed -0.70% to 92.11. Gold changed -1.44% to 3,942.8999. Bitcoin changed -1.66% to 72,738.3828. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.998%, a relative move of +0.30%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (+5.20%) and Freeport-McMoRan (+3.00%) moved the most.
